items.promptEn: Judy's roommate moved out. Judy is looking for a new roommate ________.
choices: to live
living
live with
to live with
to living with

items.sectionInstructionKo: [2] 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 어법상 쓰임이 같은 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn: <보기> Mina wants [to ride] her new bike.
choices: It is not easy to help others in need.
To read mystery novels is interesting.
They agreed to gather in the square.
It is good to keep a diary every day.
Her job is to teach elementary students.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [3–4] 다음 두 문장을 to부정사를 사용하여 한 문장으로 완성하세요. 문장 전체를 쓰세요. (첫 단어부터 마침표까지 완전한 문장으로 쓰세요.)
items.promptEn:
He wanted to take a bath.
He filled up the bathtub.
→ ________
accept: He filled up the bathtub to take a bath.
He filled up the bathtub in order to take a bath.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [3–4] 다음 두 문장을 to부정사를 사용하여 한 문장으로 완성하세요. 문장 전체를 쓰세요. (첫 단어부터 마침표까지 완전한 문장으로 쓰세요.)
items.promptEn:
I got some gifts from my cousin in Canada.
I was happy.
→ ________
accept: I was happy to get some gifts from my cousin in Canada.

items.promptEn:
① Iris went home early to take a rest.
② Do you need to work late these days?
③ I remained silent to not wake him up.
④ He planned to work abroad next year.
⑤ She likes to read books in her free time.
choices: Iris went home early to take a rest.
Do you need to work late these days?
I remained silent to not wake him up.
He planned to work abroad next year.
She likes to read books in her free time.

③ I don't know [what to eat] for lunch. (무엇을 먹을지)
④ You should tell me [what to do] next. (무엇을 할지)
⑤ He decided [where to hang] the painting. (어디에 걸지)
choices: I'll show you how to bake a pie. (얼마나 구울지)

① Please give me a chance [to try].
② Do you have any friends [to talk to]?

① [It] was totally my mistake.
② [It] is one of my favorite foods.
③ [It] is a fun app for children.
④ [It] is fun to meet new people in a new place.
⑤ [It] is very popular among me and my friends.
choices: It was totally my mistake.
It is one of my favorite foods.
It is a fun app for children.

④ [To clean] the room, I opened the window.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [11–12] 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요. 빈칸에 들어갈 말만 쓰세요. (문장 전체를 쓰지 마세요.)
items.promptEn:
Diana was so sick that she couldn't get out of her bed.
→ Diana was ________ out of her bed.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [11–12] 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요. 빈칸에 들어갈 말만 쓰세요. (문장 전체를 쓰지 마세요.)
items.promptEn:
He was so smart that he could deal with the problem.
→ He was ________ the problem.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [13] 주어진 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn: 나는 그녀에게 할 중요한 말이 있다.
choices: I have important something to tell her.
I have something important to tell her.
I have something to tell important her.
I have to tell her important something.
I have something to tell her important.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [14] 짝지어진 두 문장의 의미가 다른 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① My mom told me what to do first.
= My mom told me what I should do first.
② She was too sad to eat anything.
= She was so sad that she couldn't eat anything.
③ I am too excited to sleep right now.
= I am so excited that I can't sleep right now.
④ He visited Busan to see his grandparents.
= He visited Busan in order to see his grandparents.
⑤ Liam is tall enough to reach the top shelf.
= Liam is so tall that he can't reach the top shelf.
choices: My mom told me what to do first. = My mom told me what I should do first.
She was too sad to eat anything. = She was so sad that she couldn't eat anything.
I am too excited to sleep right now. = I am so excited that I can't sleep right now.
He visited Busan to see his grandparents. = He visited Busan in order to see his grandparents.
Liam is tall enough to reach the top shelf. = Liam is so tall that he can't reach the top shelf.

items.promptEn:
Nick: do not skip meals / stay healthy
Nancy: get good grades / please her parents

Nick won't ________.
accept: skip meals in order to stay healthy
